text: I couldn't go to museums for a long time, especially old religious art. I'd see the demons in my mind. A recurring nightmare of being inside a painting. Also some general anxiety about being judged.

Ich hatte danach lange Zeit Angst vor Herzrhythmusstörungen und habe mich nicht mehr getraut, Sport zu machen. Jedes Herzstolpern hat mich in Panik versetzt. Ich war mehrmals beim Kardiologen, der nichts gefunden hat. Erst nach etwa einem Jahr habe ich wieder angefangen zu laufen.

The physical recovery took months. I lost the tips of two toes and had nerve pain in my feet for a long time. Walking was difficult. But the psychological aftermath was worse.

For the first year I had episodes where I'd suddenly feel the white field again, a sense that I was about to disappear into it. They came especially when I was in bright light, on snowy days, or in white rooms like hospitals. During these episodes I'd lose my sense of who I was for a few seconds, and that terrified me.

I had nightmares about the cabin, the tall figures in the corners, the matches turning into insects. I couldn't stand being in small wooden rooms or being alone in the countryside.

I became very depressed. I was ashamed of my arrogance and the risk I had taken. I'd always seen myself as a responsible, experienced psychonaut, and that identity was shattered. My friend who called the rescue was angry with me for a long time. I felt that I'd betrayed everyone who cared about me.

I also had what I think was mild HPPD: visual snow and afterimages, especially on white surfaces.

It's been three years now. The episodes are rare, but winters are still hard.

Ich hatte danach lange Schuldgefühle gegenüber meinen Großeltern und konnte nicht mehr an sie denken, ohne die grauen Gesichter zu sehen. Ich hatte Albträume, in denen sie mich anklagen. Ich habe ihr Grab monatelang nicht besuchen können. Gleichzeitig hat mich die Erfahrung dazu gebracht, über meine Beziehung zu ihnen nachzudenken, und ich habe verstanden, dass ich viele Gefühle nie zugelassen habe.
Just some thinking to do about my childhood. No real problems.

For a long time I had a strong fear of police and of dogs. Barking would make my heart race. I had nightmares about insects with glowing eyes. I avoided parties for a year. I also had moments of depersonalisation, especially in dark crowded places.

Seitdem habe ich große Angst vor Insekten, vor allem im Sommer. Ich habe meinen Notfallpen immer dabei und kontrolliere ständig, ob er noch in der Tasche ist. In den ersten Monaten hatte ich Albträume, in denen sich mein Hals zuschnürt.

I've never fully forgiven myself. For the first months after the birth, I had intrusive images of that taxi ride, of the delivery room, of my son's face changing in my arms. They came at night, mostly, when I got up for feeds. Sometimes I'd look at him in his cot and feel that he wasn't real, and I'd have to touch him to be sure.

I struggled to bond with him at first, and I think the shame was part of it. I felt I didn't deserve him. My wife was understanding on the surface but there was a lot of tension between us. She told me later that she'd felt alone during the birth even though I was there.

I developed what my doctor later called paternal postnatal depression. I was irritable, exhausted beyond the normal new-parent exhaustion, and I had moments of thinking that my family would be better off without me. I was also very anxious about his health, constantly checking his breathing.

Things have improved a lot. He's three now and we're very close. But I still feel a sting every year on his birthday.

Nach dem Trip hatte ich etwa ein Jahr lang starke Derealisation. Die Welt fühlte sich an wie eine Kulisse, und die Menschen um mich herum wie Schauspieler. Ich hatte oft das Gefühl, dass ich der einzige echte Mensch bin, und habe mich dafür geschämt, weil ich wusste, dass das nicht stimmt. Ich war sehr einsam, weil ich mich niemandem nahe fühlen konnte. Ich habe Panikattacken bekommen, wenn das Gefühl besonders stark war, z.B. in vollen Bahnen. Ich hatte auch depressive Phasen und habe mein Studium für ein Semester unterbrochen. Langsam ist es besser geworden, aber an manchen Tagen kommt das Gefühl noch zurück.
I can't stand total darkness now, or floating in water. I had panic attacks in the bath for a few months. I'm better now but won't go near a float tank again.
Never again on a coach. A bit claustrophobic on buses for a while.

Ich hatte danach lange Zeit Angst vor lauten Männerstimmen und vor betrunkenen Menschen. Ich habe meine Freundin monatelang nicht besucht und mir gleichzeitig große Sorgen um sie gemacht. Ich hatte Albträume von seinem Gesicht. Ich habe mich schuldig gefühlt, dass ich gegangen bin, und konnte mit niemandem darüber sprechen, weil sie mich gebeten hatte, nichts zu erzählen.
